def sha256_of(path: Path, chunk=65536):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        while True:
            b = f.read(chunk)
            if not b: break
            h.update(b)
    return h.hexdigest()

def load_json(path: Path, default=None):

def ensure_import():

    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules["sat_full"] = mod
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    return mod

def format_table(rows, headers):
    out = []
    out.append("| " + " | ".join(headers) + " |")
    out.append("|" + "|".join(["---"]*len(headers)) + "|")
    for r in rows:
        out.append("| " + " | ".join(r) + " |")
    return "\n".join(out)

def main():
    if not LEAN_DOC.exists():
        print("HALT: LEAN_MODE.md is missing. Please re-upload LEAN_MODE.md and rerun.")
        sys.exit(3)

    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--core-in", type=str, default=str(ROOT / "SAT_CORE.md"))
    ap.add_argument("--out", type=str, default=str(ROOT / "SAT_CORE.updated.md"))
    ap.add_argument("--title", type=str, default="SAT CORE")
    ap.add_argument("--section", type=str, default="Instance Additions")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    core_in = Path(args.core_in)
    out = Path(args.out)

    sat = ensure_import()

    m_star = sat.CONSTS["scales"]["m_star_GeV"]
    m_e = sat.CONSTS["leptons"]["electron_mass_GeV"]
    m_mu = sat.CONSTS["leptons"]["muon_mass_GeV"]
    m_tau = sat.CONSTS["leptons"]["tau_mass_GeV"]
    m_H  = sat.CONSTS["leptons"]["higgs_mass_GeV"]
    lam  = sat.CONSTS["defaults"]["lambda"]

    ts = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    sha = sha256_of(SAT_FULL)

    t = sat.run_tests()
    is_green = sat.tests_green(t)

    neutrino_cfg = load_json(ROOT/"neutrino_model.json", default={})

    additions.append("**Run parameters**")
    param_rows = [

        ["λ", f"{lam}"],
        ["m_e", f"{m_e} GeV"],
        ["m_μ", f"{m_mu} GeV"],
        ["m_τ", f"{m_tau} GeV"],
        ["m_H", f"{m_H} GeV"],
        ["LEAN_MODE.md", "present"]
    ]
    additions.append(format_table(param_rows, ["Parameter","Value"]))

    additions.append("\n**Test Summary**")
    rows = [[k, "PASS" if v.get("pass") else "FAIL"] for k,v in t.items()]
    additions.append(format_table(rows, ["Test", "Result"]))
    additions.append(f"\nOverall: **{'GREEN' if is_green else 'RED'}**")

        additions.append(format_table(sweep_rows, ["λ","ΔK","m_{ℓ4} (GeV)","y_{μ4}","Δa_μ"]))    

    additions.append("\n**Predictions**")
    db_mid = sat.delta_beta_deg(1e-3, delta_theta4)
    additions.append(format_table([["Δβ at g_{θγ}=1e−3, Δθ₄=2π/3", f"{db_mid:.4f}°"]], ["Quantity","Value"]))

    additions.append("\n**Kill-Criteria Evaluation**")
    g2_ok = t.get("gminus2_window",{}).get("pass", False)

        dKs = [35, 37, 39, 41]
        mL4s = [90.0, 105.0, 140.0]
        for L in lambdas:

    bire_ok = (0.03 <= db_mid <= 0.09)

    if not is_green:

        for k,v in t.items():
